title: Hornero OS composition manifest
description: Version-pinning schema for Hornero OS release manifests. A manifest pins every composed component to an exact git commit SHA. There are no git submodules: pins are plain data, and bumps are ordinary file edits validated by scripts/check-manifests.py.

apiVersion.description: Composition API version. Bump only with a schema migration note.

kind.description: Document kind. Other kinds (EditionProfile, Release) are validated structurally by the checker.

name.description: Manifest name, e.g. hornero-0.1.0-draft. Profiles and releases reference it.

components.description: shell and config are always pinned. horneroctl is built from this repo (local). installer and iso are named future slots only.

ref.description: Branch or tag the sha was taken from. Required when status is pinned.

sha.description: Full 40-char lowercase commit SHA. Required when status is pinned, forbidden otherwise.

path.description: Subdirectory owning the component inside repo (e.g. cli/ for horneroctl).

status.description: pinned: exact sha recorded. local: built from this repo at release time. future: named slot, not resolved yet.

subject.description: Subject of the pinned commit, for human audit.
